How to make Green Apple Ice Cream Apple 🍏: Peel, core, and cut 5 Granny Smith apples into small chunks. Add the apples, 30 g water, 80 g sugar, and 10 g lemon juice to a saucepan. Cook over medium heat until the apples are completely soft, then blend until smooth. Transfer the apple puree to a shallow container. Stir in the juice of 1 lemon and ¼ cup of sugar, then freeze overnight until completely solid. (The first addition of 10g lemon juice prevents the apples from browning, while the second addition of one lemon juice is for adding a tangy flavor.) The next day, whip 200 g heavy cream, 60 g sweetened condensed milk, and 1 tsp vanilla extract until stiff peaks form. Use a fork to scrape the frozen apple puree into fine flakes. Add the flakes to the whipped cream and gently mix until evenly combined. Transfer the mixture to an airtight container and freeze overnight before serving. ❤ #tiktokrecipecontest #icecream #dessert #fruit #homecooking

Good Grooming – Neat hairstyle, trimmed beard (if any), clean nails. Wear Minimal Accessories – A simple watch and leather belt are enough. Stand Confidently – Straight posture, shoulders back, relaxed walk. Don't Overdo Logos – Quiet luxury always looks better. Smell Fresh – Light perfume or deodorant makes a big difference. 📅 1-Week Exam Study Guide 🗓️ Day 1: Plan & Prioritize 📚 Gather all your materials. 📝 List every topic. 🎯 Rank topics from weakest to strongest. ⏰ Create a realistic study timetable. 🗓️ Day 2: Understand Difficult Topics 🧠 Focus on your weak areas. ❓Use active recall instead of rereading. 🎥 Watch short explanations only if needed. 🗓️ Day 3: Practice Questions 📄 Solve past questions. ⏱️ Time yourself. ✅ Review every mistake and learn from it. 🗓️ Day 4: Boost Your Memory 🗣️ Teach the topics out loud. 🃏 Use flashcards or self-quizzes. 🔁 Briefly review what you’ve covered. 🗓️ Day 5: Mock Exam 📝 Simulate the real exam. ⏰ Stick to the exam time. 🎯 Identify and fix weak areas. 🗓️ Day 6: Final Revision 📖 Review summaries and key points. 🧩 Go over formulas, definitions, and important concepts. 😴 Sleep early. 🗓️ Day 7: Day Before the Exam 🔍 Do a light revision. 🚫 Avoid cramming. 🎒 Prepare everything you’ll need. 😌 Relax and get enough rest. ✨ Golden Rules 📵 Put your phone away. 🧠 Use active recall, not passive reading. 📄 Practice past questions daily. 💧 Stay hydrated. 🍎 Eat well. 😴 Get 7–8 hours of sleep. 🎓 Remember: Smart study beats long study. Quality always wins over quantity. #studytok #becomingisaac #motivation #students #studentmotivation

Are you studying for hours but not feeling ready when the exam comes? It’s because you’re not reviewing the information within 24 hours of learning it. Review new material within 24 hours, turn key concepts into flashcards, and use active recall instead of simply rereading. For class exams, focus on your professor’s slides, and you can upload them to a tool like Jungle if you want flashcards customized to your professor’s style. For MCAT preparation, use Anki to strengthen long-term retention. A short review today will save you from relearning everything later. Save this for your next study session and share it with someone who wants to study smarter. #StudyTips #StudySmarter #MCATPrep #Jungle #MedicalStudent

Rolled Ice Cream🍨 Ingredients: - 250 ml heavy cream - 100 ml whole milk - 2 tbsp sugar - 1 tsp vanilla extract - 8 Oreo cookies, crushed Instructions: 1. Mix the heavy cream, milk, sugar, and vanilla until smooth. 2. Pour the ice cream base onto a frozen ice cream plate. 3. Add the crushed Oreo cookies. 4. Chop and mix everything together with two metal spatulas. 5. Spread the mixture into a thin, even layer. 6. Let it freeze for about 1–2 minutes. 7. Scrape the ice cream into rolls using a metal spatula. 8. Place the rolls into a cup and top with extra crushed Oreo cookies. #tiktokgrowthchallenge #cooking #recipes
